clips.title: The story
paras: At Shadowfang Keep, Commander Springvale's spirit guards the halls where he fell. Once a devoted paladin and commander, he was slain with his men by Arugal's worgen and remains to haunt the castle.

Commander Springvale led the garrison at Shadowfang Keep in Silverpine Forest. Before the keep's ruin, he was an honorable paladin devoted to the Holy Light. After Lordaeron fell to the Scourge, he oversaw the fortress's security through those troubled days.

Archmage Arugal summoned extraplanar worgen to strengthen Dalaran's failing ranks against the undead Scourge. The wild beasts soon escaped his control and descended on Shadowfang Keep. They slaughtered Baron Silverlaine and his entire guard. Springvale died in the halls he had sworn to protect, his service cut short.
Death did not release Springvale. His ghost haunts the keep's council room with its spectral soldiers. He still wields paladin powers, including Holy Light and Hammer of Justice, against intruders.
